Description: Lab janitor: weekly sweep of lab leftovers with plan, approval and audit trail

BootstrapVersion.Description: Version of the CDK Bootstrap resources in this environment, automatically retrieved from SSM Parameter Store. [cdk:skip]

Properties.Description: Lab janitor approval handler: records decisions and resumes the run
Lab janitor detector: sweeps all regions and writes the weekly plan
Lab janitor executor: deletes the approved, re-verified plan items
Lab janitor notifier: publishes the weekly report and approval requests

Properties.AlarmDescription: Lab janitor: a scheduler start or an email delivery failed and landed in the dead-letter queue

Properties.Description: Starts the lab janitor every Monday
